connector.name: Defi MCP
connector.registryDescription: AI agent access to on-chain DeFi data on Polygon & Arbitrum: balances, positions, prices.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package defi-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the matiosera3-ops account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
